name: B-l13-edit-s211
prompt: <image1> shows a creature at its newborn stage. Draw the same creature grown into its young stage. Body change: the head becomes much smaller in relation to the body; the body grows three times longer and slender like an otter, with a clear neck; four small paddle flippers grow out; it rears up on its tail in a playful S-curve. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, three feathery coral gill fronds on each side of the head like an axolotl, and one continuous cream belly stripe running from the chin to the tip of the tail, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
